description: This source file implements the core functions for handling web virtual host processing within a web server. It includes functions for querying resource paths, processing requests, handling notifications, constructing responses, adding headers, and constructing resource paths based on request information and headers.

methods.name: ULONG WebVhoQuery(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoReq,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoRep,PANSC_HANDLE phQueryContext)
methods.description: Examines a web request message and determines the HTTP status code based on resource path lookup and resource owner retrieval.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WebVhoProcess(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoReq,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoRep,ANSC_HANDLE hQueryContext)
methods.description: Processes a web request message by identifying the session, invoking resource-specific processing, and adding headers to the response.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WebVhoNotify(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoReq,ULONG ulEvent)
methods.description: Handles web request events, primarily updating session activity timestamp.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WebVhoConstructResponse(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoReq,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoRep,ULONG ulStatusCode)
methods.description: Constructs and sets the HTTP response info for a given request, including status code and reason phrase.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WebVhoAddHttpRepHeaders(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoRep)
methods.description: Adds standard HTTP headers to the response, including cookies for session management.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WebVhoGetResourcePath(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoReq,ANSC_HANDLE hTokenChain,BOOL bReferred)
methods.description: Constructs the resource URI path for the request, considering referer and host headers for relative paths.
